description: Daily cash price history for one grain commodity in one state, from the same USDA MARS daily reports behind get_grain_price. Use for trends or day-over-day comparison; use get_grain_price instead when only the latest quote matters. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Each row carries date, price, unit and source, plus price_low/price_high and change_amount/change_pct when the source report publishes them (null otherwise). Default: up to `periods` most recent daily report rows, oldest first (`periods` counts report rows, not calendar days; default 30, max 365). Pass start_date and/or end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) instead to get every stored report inside that inclusive date range (max 1000 rows), returned as an object with the range actually returned and an observation count. Stored reports currently reach back to 2026-07-17 for IL/IA (other tracked regions from 2026-10-09) and grow daily.

geography.description: State/region code from a tracked MARS report (e.g. IL, IA, TX, PNW, GULF). Default: IL

periods.description: Number of most recent report rows to return (default 30, max 365). Ignored when start_date/end_date are given.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive range start (YYYY-MM-DD). With start_date/end_date, returns all stored reports in range instead of the most recent `periods`.

name: get_grain_history
